newsitem.title: USA: Two PacifiCorp Bridger units said off-line.
newsitem.headline: Two PacifiCorp Bridger units said off-line.

text.p: PacifiCorp sources said Friday two of the four 550 MW units at the Jim Bridger coal-fired power plant in Wyoming were off-line.
The plant's unit 2 tripped off around 0400 MDT Friday due to a leak, they said. An exact timeframe for the outage was not available, but repairs were described as fairly routine.
Bridger's unit 3, which has been down since Saturday, continued to be idled by trouble with a boiler valve.
Sources familiar with the Bridger plant said Thursday that unit 3 would be back up Friday, but that now appears unlikely, according to plant sources.
